roadmap.title: Basic to Advanced JavaScript Fundamentals
roadmap.goal: Build the JavaScript depth required to reason about Angular, RxJS and browser behavior.

topics.title: Execution Context, Scope & Hoisting
theory: Call stack, lexical environment and scope chain
Global scope, function scope and block scope
hands: Predict the output of nested function and scope examples.
Create examples showing var, let, const and TDZ behavior.
Draw the execution context and scope chain for nested functions.
interview: Is let hoisted? Yes, but access before initialization is blocked by the TDZ.
Explain the difference between function scope and block scope.
What happens when JavaScript executes a function?

topics.title: Closures
theory: A closure is a function retaining access to variables from its lexical scope after the outer function has returned.
hands: Build counter(), once(), memoize() and a factory function.
Explain why the returned function still accesses count.
Create a closure-based private state implementation.
interview: Where are closures useful in real applications?
How can closures contribute to memory retention?
Explain closures using a real Angular example.

topics.title: Event Loop & Asynchronous JavaScript
theory: Call Stack, Web APIs and Event Loop
Promise callbacks, setTimeout and DOM events
hands: Create 20 event-loop examples and predict output before executing them.
Build a dashboard that concurrently loads users, products and orders.
Create examples involving nested promises, timers and async/await.
interview: Why does Promise run before setTimeout(..., 0)?
Does async/await create a new thread?
What is the difference between microtasks and macrotasks?

topics.title: Prototypes, this & Inheritance
theory: Classes as syntax over the prototype system
hands: Compare class syntax with constructor/prototype syntax.
Create examples using call(), apply() and bind().
interview: Arrow function vs normal function for this?
How does property lookup work through the prototype chain?
What is the difference between call, apply and bind?

topics.title: Memory Management
theory: Timers, event listeners, subscriptions and closures
hands: Create and fix examples involving timers and event listeners.
Use browser DevTools memory tools to inspect retained objects.
Find and fix a simulated memory leak in an Angular application.
interview: What causes a frontend memory leak?
How do you clean up timers and subscriptions?
Why can a closure retain a large object?
What is the difference between WeakMap and Map?

topics.title: JavaScript Practical Coding
theory: Array methods: map, filter, reduce, forEach, find, some, every
hands: Implement debounce(), throttle(), memoize() and a simple EventEmitter.
Solve data transformation scenarios using map/filter/reduce.
Implement deepClone() for common object types.
interview: How would you safely clone nested data?
What is the difference between == and ===?
What is immutability and why is it useful?

roadmap.title: TypeScript Mastery
roadmap.goal: Develop strong type-system knowledge required for large-scale Angular applications.

topics.title: TypeScript Fundamentals
hands: Convert a JavaScript utility library to TypeScript.
Create interfaces for API request and response models.
Replace unnecessary any types with safe alternatives.

topics.title: Generics & Advanced Types
hands: Build a reusable generic table configuration.
Implement reusable Pick, Omit and Partial patterns.

topics.title: Advanced TypeScript Patterns
interview: When should function overloads be used?
Compile-time type checking vs runtime validation?

roadmap.title: HTML, CSS & Browser Fundamentals
roadmap.goal: Master the platform underneath Angular instead of depending only on framework abstractions.

topics.title: Semantic HTML & Accessibility
hands: Build an accessible form without Angular.
Create keyboard-accessible modal, dropdown and tabs.
Audit an existing page for accessibility problems.
interview: How do you make a modal accessible?

topics.title: CSS Layout & Responsive Design
hands: Recreate a complex layout using Grid and Flexbox.
Create a responsive sidebar and mobile navigation.
interview: How would you design responsive layouts?

topics.title: CSS Architecture & Design Systems
hands: Create reusable button, input, modal and card components.
interview: How would you structure CSS for a large application?
How do you prevent CSS from becoming difficult to maintain?

roadmap.title: Browser, Web Platform & HTTP
roadmap.goal: Understand how frontend applications communicate with and execute inside the browser.

topics.title: DOM, BOM & Rendering
hands: Build a vanilla JavaScript event delegation example.
Create and optimize a large dynamic list.

topics.title: HTTP, REST & API Communication
hands: Build a CRUD application using a REST API.
Handle loading, success and error states consistently.
interview: How should frontend applications handle API errors?

topics.title: Frontend Web Security
hands: Create an XSS demonstration in a safe local project.
interview: Where should authentication tokens be stored?

roadmap.title: Angular Fundamentals to Advanced
roadmap.goal: Become highly proficient in modern Angular and understand the framework internals instead of only using APIs.

topics.title: Angular Core Fundamentals
hands: Build a multi-page Angular CRUD application.

topics.title: Lifecycle, Change Detection & Rendering
hands: Build the same screen using traditional bindings and signals.
Optimize a slow component using OnPush and immutable data.

topics.title: Angular Router
interview: Can a frontend guard provide real security?
How would you design permission-based routing?

topics.title: Angular Forms
interview: How do you create async validators?
How would you validate dependent fields?

topics.title: HttpClient, Interceptors & API Architecture
hands: Build a reusable API service layer.
interview: How do you handle expired tokens?
How do you prevent duplicate API requests?

roadmap.title: RxJS & Reactive Programming
roadmap.goal: Master RxJS deeply enough to design predictable asynchronous Angular applications.

topics.title: RxJS Fundamentals
interview: What causes an Observable to execute?

topics.title: RxJS Operators
hands: Build concurrent API loading using forkJoin.
Prevent duplicate form submissions using exhaustMap.
Create dependent API calls using switchMap.

topics.title: RxJS Subscription & Memory Management
hands: Refactor nested subscriptions into operator chains.
interview: How do RxJS subscriptions cause memory leaks?
Why should nested subscriptions usually be avoided?
How do you cancel an Observable?

roadmap.title: State Management & Application Architecture
roadmap.goal: Learn how to structure large frontend applications with predictable state and clear boundaries.

topics.title: State Management Fundamentals
hands: Build a feature without global state.
Refactor shared state into a centralized store.
Separate server state from UI state.
interview: Why should state updates be predictable?

topics.title: Angular Signals for State
hands: Build a shopping cart using signals.
Create a filterable data table using computed signals.
Integrate signals with HTTP and RxJS.
interview: When should RxJS still be preferred?

topics.title: NgRx & Redux Architecture
hands: Build an enterprise CRUD feature using NgRx.

roadmap.title: Frontend Architecture & Design Patterns
roadmap.goal: Develop senior-level skills for designing maintainable enterprise frontend systems.

topics.title: Large-Scale Frontend Architecture
hands: Design an enterprise Angular application from scratch.
Split an application into independent business domains.
Define boundaries between shared, core and feature code.
interview: How would you structure a large Angular application?
What belongs in shared vs core?
How do you prevent circular dependencies?
How do you decide component boundaries?

topics.title: Frontend Design Patterns
hands: Implement a facade for a complex feature.
Create a strategy-based form validation system.
Build an adapter for inconsistent API responses.
interview: Which design patterns have you used in frontend applications?

topics.title: Reusable Component & Design System Architecture
hands: Build a reusable enterprise data table.
Create a small internal component library.
interview: How do you design reusable components?
What makes a component too generic?
How do you avoid prop/input explosion?
How would you design an enterprise data table?

roadmap.title: Frontend Performance & Scalability
roadmap.goal: Learn how to diagnose and optimize real production applications.

topics.title: Web Performance Fundamentals
hands: Measure page-load performance before and after optimization.
interview: How would you diagnose a slow Angular application?
How do you reduce main-thread work?

topics.title: Angular Performance Optimization
hands: Use deferred loading for expensive UI.
interview: How do you optimize a large Angular application?
When should virtual scrolling be used?
How do you identify unnecessary change detection?

topics.title: Network & Bundle Optimization
interview: How would you reduce initial bundle size?

roadmap.title: Testing & Code Quality
roadmap.goal: Build confidence in production code through unit, integration and end-to-end testing.

topics.title: Unit Testing
hands: Write tests for services and utility functions.
interview: What makes a good unit test?
What should not be unit tested?
How do you test asynchronous code?

topics.title: Integration & Component Testing
hands: Test API success and error scenarios.
interview: How would you test route guards?
How do you test HTTP failures?

topics.title: End-to-End Testing
hands: Create E2E tests for login and checkout.
Create tests for critical business workflows.
interview: What should be covered by E2E tests?
Why do E2E tests become flaky?
How do you design stable selectors?
How do you balance unit and E2E testing?

roadmap.title: Git, CI/CD & Production Engineering
roadmap.goal: Become capable of owning frontend delivery from development through production.

topics.title: Git & Team Collaboration
hands: Create feature branches and clean PRs.
interview: How do you handle a bad production commit?

topics.title: CI/CD & Deployment
hands: Run lint, tests and build automatically.
Create separate development, UAT and production configurations.
interview: What happens in a frontend CI pipeline?
How should environment variables be managed?
How would you roll back a broken frontend deployment?
What checks should run before deployment?

topics.title: Production Debugging & Observability
hands: Track and reproduce a frontend performance issue.
interview: How do you debug a production-only issue?
What information should frontend errors capture?
How do source maps help debugging?
How would you investigate a sudden increase in frontend errors?

roadmap.title: Frontend System Design
roadmap.goal: Develop the architecture and trade-off reasoning expected from Senior Frontend and Architect-level interviews.

topics.title: Frontend System Design Fundamentals
interview: How would you design a large frontend application?
How do you identify architectural boundaries?
How do you make frontend architecture scalable?
How do you evaluate architectural trade-offs?

topics.title: Advanced Frontend System Design
hands: Design a monorepo for multiple frontend applications.
Design a shared component and utility library.
Define communication between independent frontend domains.
interview: How would multiple frontend applications share authentication?
How would you prevent shared libraries from becoming a bottleneck?

topics.title: Enterprise Architecture Case Studies
hands: Design a complete enterprise ERP frontend.
Design a role and permission system.
Design a multi-tenant frontend with configurable branding.
interview: How would you design permission-based UI?
How would you architect a configurable enterprise application?
How would you handle 100,000+ records in a frontend?
How would you design a real-time dashboard?
How would you design a frontend for multiple tenants?

roadmap.title: Senior Frontend Interview Preparation
roadmap.goal: Convert technical knowledge into strong interview performance through coding, debugging, architecture and communication practice.

topics.title: JavaScript Interview Problems
interview: Explain the event loop from memory.
Explain closure using a production example.

topics.title: Angular Interview Preparation
hands: Build an Angular feature within 60 minutes.
interview: How would you structure an enterprise Angular application?

topics.title: Frontend Coding & Problem Solving
hands: Practice 2 timed coding problems per week.
Explain time and space complexity for every solution.
Implement common data structures from scratch.
interview: Explain Big O of your solution.
How would you optimize this algorithm?
Can you solve the problem without extra memory?

topics.title: Frontend System Design Interview
hands: Draw component, state and data-flow diagrams.
interview: Design a Google Docs-like collaborative application.

roadmap.title: Capstone Projects & Real-World Engineering
roadmap.goal: Combine all skills into production-style applications that demonstrate Senior Frontend capability.

topics.title: Enterprise CRUD Application
hands: Build a complete enterprise admin application.
Add loading, error and empty states.
interview: Explain how you would scale the application.

topics.title: Real-Time Dashboard
interview: How would you prevent excessive rendering?
How would you scale a real-time frontend?

topics.title: Enterprise SaaS Application
hands: Create a reusable enterprise design system.
interview: How would you architect the application for 100+ teams?
How would you isolate tenant data at the frontend?
How would you design the shared component system?
What would you change if the application grew 10x?
